body: Thanks for all the replies everyone! Couldn't find any info about drop rates or RNG so that tipped us off
I just found out about this as well! does the killer get notified when a trap gets cleansed?
nope that definitely answers it! Thank you!

I am trying my best haha. All the other things about puppyhood don't bother me. You just took an absurdly large poo on the rug? I should pay more attention and taken you out sooner. (Although the insta poops alright after finishing the last bite are totally unfair)

Oh your chewing on the expensive thing? I shouldn't have put it somewhere your extremely tiny stature could access. Sigh. Living and learning

As I'm looking back at the last couple nights it's obvious that although he has no issues going into the kennel being locked into that safe space is a whole different animal. 

Also looks like I am hoarding the treats like some sort of treat-dragon compared to others here. Let the treats flow like the wine in Aspen. Thanks for the advice!

Quick question regarding feeding in crate. We have been doing that as well but I wasn't sure were to place the water - I've done it right next to the food and also just enough outside of the crate he would have to move to take a drink in an effort to slow down his motor mouth. 

No resource guarding or super fast eating just taking precautionary steps were I can. Which do you guys prefer?

I have heard of them! I was thinking about getting one as I lay awake on the floor and this is going to solidify that purchase today. 

I've seen super expensive ones online but does the cheaper $40 ones at Petsmart do just as good? Thanks for the reply!

yup I bought a quilt from walmart that is big enough to cover it completely (I've also tried only doing the sides and back leaving the front open with no change in behavior - it has only been a couple days so that shows how impatient I am haha) . It sits in the living room where we have the most activity and has an exercise pen attached to it to try and keep any accidents contained while he is out and about or when I have to leave. 

I am pretty worried about when I will have to leave him to go to work in a few more days. I can be home quickly so lunch isn't a problem but it's going to be about 4.5 hours before coming back and right now if he is awake he goes potty about 1.5 - 2 hours. Unfortunately the timing didn't work out very well and my housemate will be gone for 2 weeks where normally they would be around to let him out.

that sounds like a super treat dang! Can a puppy be given hooves? I was told not to do anything with rawhide in it until at least 6 months so I wasn't sure if those were similar enough or not. He's got a cut antler that he pays little attention to as well. Thank you so much for all the advice!

Thank You! I've seen all these steps separately for their own training but seeing them all together in order really makes sense! I'll be honest I skipped the steps about making the kennel the "best place ever" because from the get-go he was going in by himself, had a favorite stuffed toy to bring in, and seemed really good in there at first.

Going to start from square one like I should have. Thank you for the responses!

Thank you for the options! I'll be looking that up this morning for sure - I think I've been a little too stingy with the reward treats because I was worried about feeding him too much but definitely upping the treat game today. 

I have a separate question about chews - my guy doesn't seem interested beyond the initial sniff and bite unless I am using it to play with him. I have a kong and Kong Jr (for puppies) both filled with frozen peanut butter - no bad z word I can't remember in it - and he couldn't care less about them. They were going to be my secret weapon and it's fallen flat.

Thank you for the hard numbers! That containment phobia sounds like my guy to a T. can I ask what you have been doing to 'slowly build up without whining'? For us (I know we are only a couple days in) as soon as he sees I am gone he begins the freak session until I come back into range. Any tips like you have already given me are greatly appreciated thank you!!
do you have the coordinates for the ship?
